text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the URA Awards ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So this is the place specified on the 
map... Hmm. It seems to be quite a 
prestigious establishment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems this year's award ceremony is 
being held at a different venue... It 
feels quite solemn from the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, looks like coming right away paid 
off. Look, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll finally get to see them with my own 
eyes. ...Those peerless, ferocious 
warriors.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, and Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen... The pinnacle stayer of 
the Umamusume world, having won 
back-to-back victories in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)—the ultimate stage to determine 
the strongest over long distances.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Mihono Bourbon is an 
Umamusume who wields a physique and 
stamina forged through intense training as 
her greatest weapons. She has even been 
named Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And over on the other side was Oguri Cap 
and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Emerging from the local circuit, Oguri Cap 
took the Central League by storm. It's no 
exaggeration to call her the top Umamusume 
in both skill and popularity.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Symboli Rudolf, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. So there are other guests invited 
besides the award winners, as a way to 
appreciate their hard work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I saw today's guest of honor, so I 
came over to say hello a step ahead of the 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Making racing silks the dress code this 
year was apparently planned with you in 
mind. Something about how an Umamusume is 
at her best in clothes made for running—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I've had enough of your pedantic 
explanations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wha--!? My head is not big!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I wasn't talking about Sis's head.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, let's hurry up and head 
inside.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
After all is said and done, you did 
prepare an acceptance speech, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ………… ……A comment?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ! N-No way, could you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Do you really understand?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, this year's Umamusume of the 
Year, Narita Brian! Please come up to the 
podium!”

text_block_list.name: Surroundings
text_block_list.text: Ohh...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's got serious presence! If 
she keeps this up, she might even surpass 
Rudolf, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You'd want to see a direct showdown too, 
wouldn't you~? Just which one of them is 
truly the strongest?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on your award! Narita 
Brian!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
U-Ummm... so! Now then, who is the first 
person you would like to share your 
feelings about winning this award with?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...That is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: To the mighty Umamusume gathered here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I have only just finished my Classic year. 
From here on, I race in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's why, even if I'm hailed as 
Umamusume of the Year, I haven't even 
competed against every Umamusume gathered 
here. Is that really... what it means to 
be the strongest?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No. Such things are fleeting. I wouldn't 
mind returning both the supplementary 
prize and the title right now.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I ask the Umamusume gathered 
here: "Will you compete for the top?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ――To see who is stronger: you guys, or me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —That is all.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second, please! I still have 
plans..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Not for me. The rest will be settled on 
the track.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...Good grief. A declaration of war 
against every single Umamusume...?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Th-This isn't just about surpassing 
Rudolph! It's entirely unprecedented!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, contact the editorial department! 
Tomorrow's front page is 'Brian's 
Unprecedented Provocation!'

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"We ask the 'Emperor' and all other 
Umamusume. Who will be the one to defeat 
Narita Brian?!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You've really gone and made an outrageous 
statement, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I finally found Narita Brian, she was 
standing alone outside the venue.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: That was quite a bold statement to make.
That was quite a bold statement to make.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who told me to answer 
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I just want to compete more. And I want to 
win. That is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether aware of what was to come or not, 
Narita Brian gave a fearless smile.
